name: database-sqlite
title: database-sqlite
description: Copied SQLite database component. You own its files. Needs the starter's Reylo toolchain (TypeScript 7.1 beta, reylo/vite, contentMappers, sqlite-dev-db); not installable onto the `app` item yet.

files.content:
export type { Database } from "./types";
export { databaseUrl } from "./database.server";

select coalesce(max(id), 0) as id
from start_notify
where channel = :channel

insert into start_notify (channel, payload, created_at)
values (:channel, :payload, :created_at)

select id, payload
from start_notify
where channel = :channel and id > :after
order by id

meta.update: Run tinker update <name> to replace the whole folder; it stops on local edits recorded in tinker/components.lock. tinker check reports edits and outdated copies.
meta.starterOnlyWhy: it needs the starter's Reylo toolchain (TypeScript 7.1 beta, reylo/vite, contentMappers, sqlite-dev-db)
